title: Legal detriment and surrender of freedom
shortTitle: Legal detriment and surrender of freedom
summary: A requested surrender of a legal right can be consideration even when the surrender improves the promisee’s welfare.
notes: Hamer rejects the assumption that consideration must make the promisee worse off in a financial or health sense. The surrendered ability to act supplies the relevant legal change when requested as part of the bargain. The same chapter cautions that a detriment merely happening after a promise is not sufficient: the promisor must have sought it in exchange.
